name: tokenbar
title: TokenBar
description: Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Windsurf and any AI usage limits (5h / 7d) in the menu bar, read from the local TokenBar app.
author: chaconlucas

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: AI Usage in Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: TokenBar
commands.description: Shows the usage of each AI (5h / 7d windows) in the menu bar, with the time left until each reset.

commands.name: usage
commands.title: Show AI Usage
commands.subtitle: TokenBar
commands.description: Lists every AI with its usage windows, reset countdown and details.

preferences.name: window
preferences.title: Menu Bar Window
preferences.description: Which usage window the menu bar title shows.

preferences.name: providers
preferences.title: AIs
preferences.description: Comma-separated AI ids to show (e.g. claude, codex). Empty shows all.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
